name: Gasthof Ranalt
beschreibung:
Deep in the Stubai Valley near the foot of soaring glacier peaks, Alpengasthof Ranalt is a beloved haven for mountaineers and skiers. Cosy timbered parlours and rustic cooking ensure warm relaxation.

The Stubai Glacier, the WildeWasserWeg trail, and the thundering Grawa Waterfall are right nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Alpengasthof Ranalt in Neustift offers high-alpine serenity on the ascent to the Stubai Glacier.
